name: Zeroheight
description: Zeroheight is a design system documentation platform that creates a single source of truth by pulling together design and code, positioned as "design system management for teams building with AI."
best_for: Designers, engineers, and leadership at organizations of any maturity stage (early-stage, scaling, or enterprise) who need to document and distribute a design system so teams and AI agents build from it consistently.
features: Documentation tools for creating and updating design system content
Delivery tools for distributing the design system across teams and products
Workflow automation and security controls for managing content at scale
Native integrations with Figma, Storybook, GitHub, and GitLab
Content APIs and custom plugins for surfacing design knowledge in other tools

alternatives.name: Archbee
alternatives.description: A knowledge portal platform for turning documentation into searchable, interactive customer-facing portals.
alternatives.best_for: Technical teams building customer self-service docs.

alternatives.name: Docusaurus
alternatives.description: An open source static site generator for building documentation websites with Markdown/MDX and React.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a self-hosted, code-based documentation site.
